experience.title: Senior Full Stack Java Developer
bullets: Developed scalable healthcare applications using Java 17/21, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Cloud, and microservices to support patient, provider, clinical, and healthcare operational workflows.
Built and enhanced RESTful and GraphQL APIs for patient, provider, appointment, eligibility, clinical, claims, and healthcare administration services.
Implemented healthcare integrations using HL7 v2.x, FHIR R4, JSON, XML, and REST-based interfaces to exchange patient and clinical information across healthcare systems.
Developed event-driven healthcare services using Apache Kafka, AWS SQS, and asynchronous messaging to process clinical, patient, notification, and transaction events.
Designed secure backend services using Spring Security 6, OAuth 2.1, JWT, Okta, and RBAC to enforce authentication and authorization across healthcare applications and APIs.
Developed responsive healthcare user interfaces using React 18, Angular 16+, TypeScript, Redux, Material UI, and Tailwind CSS for clinical, administrative, and operational users.
Implemented reusable React and Angular components, form validations, state management, API integrations, and responsive workflows for patient and healthcare-provider applications.
Developed data-access services using Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, and Elasticsearch, optimizing queries and persistence strategies for healthcare workloads.
Modernized legacy healthcare applications by decomposing monolithic functionality into Docker-based Spring Boot microservices and deploying workloads through Kubernetes and AWS ECS.
Implemented cloud-native solutions on AWS using ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, and related services to support secure and scalable healthcare applications.
Automated infrastructure provisioning and environment configuration using Terraform and AWS CDK across development, QA, staging, and production environments.
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and GitLab CI/CD for automated builds, testing, security validation, containerization, and application deployments.
Implemented healthcare application observability using Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Kibana, and CloudWatch to monitor application health, service performance, logs, and operational metrics.

Improved application performance through Redis caching, PostgreSQL query optimization, connection-pool tuning, asynchronous processing, Elasticsearch indexing, and efficient microservice communication.
Developed asynchronous processing and scheduled services for healthcare notifications, patient workflows, document processing, data synchronization, and downstream system integrations.

Implemented healthcare data protection practices aligned with HIPAA and PHI requirements, including secure API communication, access controls, encryption, audit logging, and controlled handling of sensitive patient information.

Integrated Python-based services and machine learning capabilities using TensorFlow and scikit-learn to support healthcare analytics and predictive-use-case integrations while keeping ML workloads separated from core Java services.
Implemented automated unit, integration, API, and component testing using JUnit 5, Mockito, Spring Boot Test, REST Assured, and frontend testing frameworks.

Participated in technical design discussions, code reviews, production troubleshooting, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and Agile/Scrum ceremonies, while mentoring developers and promoting maintainable engineering practices.
Collaborated with healthcare analysts, product owners, QA engineers, DevOps teams, and business stakeholders to translate clinical and operational requirements into scalable full-stack solutions.
